notes: Official Sushi Hub Australia Our Products page publishes protein, total fat, carbohydrate, and energy in kJ for each listed product; calories here are converted using 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ and rounded to one decimal.

Product cards repeat the nutrition layout without a table boundary; Grilled Tamagoyaki uses its own 6.9 g protein, 14.7 g fat, 19 g carbohydrate, and 983 kJ values rather than the adjacent Tempura Veggie row.
Serving weights are not published on the product page, so serving_size_g is omitted.
The Sushi Hub allergen PDF linked from the products page is dated July 2024 and warns that traces may transfer during processing, storage, or store preparation; do not treat these as allergen-free.
Vegetarian suitability is inferred from item names and product category naming on the official page, not from a dedicated vegetarian nutrition table.
Sushi Hub has several fish/seafood items with egg, tuna, crab, unagi, salmon, or prawn in the name; these are excluded even when they may look similar to vegetarian rolls.
Some vegetarian sushi is low protein. This proposal favours tofu, meat-free chicken, egg, edamame, and the vegetarian box where official macro values are explicit.
